description.value:
Prerequisites: Lay on Hands class feature

The white mage can infuse an item with her healing powers as full-round action. The item can contain a single use of the lay on hands class feature. When filled with this magic, it begins to glow with a pearly white light. The wearer of the item can order it to release its energy as a standard action. This acts identically to receiving the effect of lay on hands directly from the person who channeled it, including any blessings they had at the time. While a item contains a use of lay on hands, the white mage cannot recover it.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - White Mage (Advanced Mage Talents)
